knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Age is a screening prompt. It neither confirms nor rules out lead, so the finish is screened before it is disturbed.
An unidentified fabric or backing is screened first, because backings can contain materials that need screening.
The record holds the identification facts, the unknowns and the photographs, so the next step can be checked.

practicalCriteria: Identification record and photographs completed before any work
Unknown layers and backings recorded with the screening step they trigger
No disturbing test carried out on an unknown finish
passRule: Knowledge checks: 80% or higher. With three checks this means all three must be correct. Practical sign-off is separate: every practical criterion must be observed and met by the assessor. A knowledge pass is not practical competence and does not count toward sign-off.
stopWorkCriteria: Unknown finish or backing disturbed before screening
